newsitem.title: USA: Apple co-founder Jobs to sell 1.5 mln shrs. [CORRECTED 11:05 GMT 31/5]
newsitem.headline: Apple co-founder Jobs to sell 1.5 mln shrs. [CORRECTED 11:05 GMT 31/5]

text.p: Apple Computer Inc. Friday registered to sell 1.5 million shares of stock owned by co-founder Steven Jobs. (Clarifies that the filing is a registration statement to sell stock in a secondary offering).
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Apple said the sale was related to the Cupertino, Calif.-based computer maker's acquistion of Jobs' firm Next Software Inc. in February.
After the sale is completed Jobs, who recently rejoined the troubled computer maker as an advisor to Chairman Gilbert Amelio, will own one share of Apple stock.
Apple is selling the shares in a secondary offering.
A spokesman for Apple was not available to comment on the sale.
